blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Far Eastern University–DN Steel still has more songs to play after punching its ticket to the semifinals of the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference, all thanks to Lirick Mendoza’s heroics. With their backs against the wall, Mendoza stepped up when it mattered most and powered the Tamaraws to a semifinal seat-clinching win over erstwhile surging Alpha Insurance, 33-31, 25-18, 19-25, 25-20, on Wednesday at the FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Mendoza dropped 18 points on 11 attacks and seven blocks as FEU-DN Steel snapped the Protectors’ five-game winning streak and secured its ticket to the next round. […]...
